label: Common App: your story
text: Some students have a background, identity, interest, or talent so meaningful they believe their application would be incomplete without it. Share your story.

label: Common App: a setback
text: The lessons we take from obstacles we encounter can be fundamental to later success. Recount a time when you faced a challenge, setback, or failure. How did it affect you, and what did you learn from the experience?

label: Common App: questioning a belief
text: Reflect on a time when you questioned or challenged a belief or idea. What prompted your thinking? What was the outcome?

label: Common App: gratitude
text: Reflect on something that someone has done for you that has made you happy or thankful in a surprising way. How has this gratitude affected or motivated you?

label: Common App: personal growth
text: Discuss an accomplishment, event, or realization that sparked a period of personal growth and a new understanding of yourself or others.

label: Common App: a captivating topic
text: Describe a topic, idea, or concept you find so engaging that it makes you lose all track of time. Why does it captivate you? What or who do you turn to when you want to learn more?

label: Common App: topic of your choice
text: Share an essay on any topic of your choice. It can be one you have already written, one that responds to a different prompt, or one of your own design.

label: Why this university
text: Why are you interested in this university, and how will its programmes and community help you reach your goals?

label: Scholarship motivation letter
text: Describe your goals, your achievements so far, and how this scholarship will help you contribute to your community.

label: Statement of purpose
text: Describe your academic background, research or professional experience, why you want this programme, and your plans after the degree.

label: UCAS personal statement
text: Why do you want to study this course? How have your qualifications and studies helped you prepare? What else have you done to prepare outside of education?
